verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS identity and payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no data-export feature, export format, or bulk download of account, transaction or wallet history. The open KYAPay JWT token format and a wallet-balance API are adjacent interoperability and building-block features, not an export-and-leave capability, and account deactivation is documented only in terms of token handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
